desc: time zone conversion with the embedded IANA database (time is an input, no clock)
usage:
<time> <to-zone> or <time> <from-zone> <to-zone>; times: RFC 3339, 2006-01-02 15:04[:05], 2006-01-02, unix seconds
JSON form: {"time":"2026-10-07T12:00:00Z","from":"UTC","to":"Europe/Paris"}
out: <RFC3339 in zone> <abbr> offset=+HH:MM dst= zone=  then unix= utc= weekday=

examples.out:
2026-10-07T14:00:00+02:00 CEST offset=+02:00 dst=true zone=Europe/Paris
unix=1791460800 utc=2026-10-07T12:00:00Z weekday=Wednesday
